confidence_notes: Holistic estimates for July 2026. Restaurant prices are more certain than lodging, which can vary with season and tourism demand. Cocktail and wine estimates use their usual local price premium over domestic beer; wine is less commonly priced.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Honduran regional cities, with a modest lodging premium for La Ceiba’s role as a coastal tourism gateway; expected to be less expensive than the Bay Islands.
